items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I know a fellow by the name of Ferman Tapp that has a band ... He say, Can you read the music. I said, Don't you worry about it. And we worked down there for, I worked there for the three month period.

ctx.x: He said I know a guy who needs a trumpet player. Yeah? I tell you what you do. You want to get your card, don't you? Yeah, I sure do. I know a fellow by the name of Ferman Tapp that has a band ... at one time, according to what the people say, you pay more money than any body in Harlem. I don't know. Anyhow, he said, you go over and see this fellow and you hang out? I said, No, I don't hang out. ... Don't hang out. You go on and make your deal and I'll come by and see you or you come by to see me. He say, Can you…
And Ferman Tapp was a banjo player?
